summary: MediWound Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a November 3, 2026 underwriting agreement with H.C. Wainwright for a marketed follow-on offering of 1,200,000 ordinary shares at $12.50 per share, a $12.09 net price to the company, plus a 30-day option for 180,000 shares exercised in full on November 4, 2026. Gross proceeds are approximately $17.25 million before discounts and expenses, under the existing Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-285908); closing is expected on or about November 5, 2026, with 60-day company and officer/director lock-ups. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing pressure and post-deal overhang.
